item.title: [Due in 6 days] Copilot in the Power Automate designer for cloud flows and agent flows ends support on 30 November 2026
item.description:
Makers will move natural-language flow building to external AI assistants and MCP connections, which are outside the Power Automate designer's own controls.

Power Platform · deadline 2026-11-30 · Tell Power Automate makers; review whether the Power Automate plugin for GitHub Copilot or the Copilot Studio MCP route is allowed in your tenant.

item.title: [Due in 6 days] App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com retire on 30 November 2026; new app creation stops mid-October
item.description:
Apps built by makers in these two experiences hold data connections; migrating them into Copilot Studio or Copilot Cowork changes where they run and who owns them, and an app that is not migrated silently stops being reachable.

Power Platform · deadline 2026-11-30 · Identify makers using App Builder or vibe.powerapps.com, tell them about the 30 November date, and review the migrated apps' connections and sharing in Copilot Studio as they move.

item.title: [New] Copilot Studio workflows can be owned by a service principal instead of a user account (GA by 17 December)
item.description:
Workflows owned by app registrations move automation out of user sign-in monitoring and into workload-identity monitoring, where credential hygiene is often weaker.

Copilot Studio · Require owners and credential expiry review for any app registration used to own Copilot Studio workflows; include them in workload identity Conditional Access if licensed.
